name: Yamazaki Susumu
source:
An officer and secret agent of the Shinsengumi who is serious and dedicated to his work. Pure and honest by nature, he often finds himself the target of Okita's teasing. Don't be deceived by his cute looks--the moment he has work to do, he carries it out with cool precision. He doesn't say much, but he seems interested in the protagonist.

[Edited from [url=https://www.cyikemen.com/DestinedToLove/pc/index.html]official website[/url]]
